A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the $m_T$ spectra of mesons and non-strange baryons are well described by a blast wave model with a common temperature $T$ = 165 MeV.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the $m_T$ spectra of all the mesons follow $m_T^2$ scaling in all the collision systems at both RHIC and Lhc energies, while the baryons do not follow this scaling.
